# Cooking
A good meal goes a long way on a long deployment. This guide covers the kitchen equipment, the basic ingredients you make yourself, and every microwave recipe.
## Equipment
- [bold]Microwave[/bold]: where nearly all cooking happens. Put the solid ingredients in, pour in any liquids, then start it. If the contents don't match a recipe, you get burnt mess instead. Never put metal in it. - [bold]All-In-One Grinder[/bold]: [bold]grind[/bold] food into its reagents (wheat into flour, for example) or [bold]juice[/bold] fruit and vegetables. Load the items, attach a beaker, then pick grind or juice. - [bold]Meat spike[/bold]: hang a dead animal on it to butcher it into meat. - [bold]Knives[/bold]: use a knife on food to slice it, such as cutting meat into cutlets or dough into slices. A rolling pin flattens dough. - [bold]Fridge[/bold]: stores ingredients and finished meals.
## Basic Ingredients Many recipes start from ingredients you mix in a beaker or bowl rather than cook. - [bold]Dough[/bold]: 45u flour and 15u water. - [bold]Pie dough[/bold]: 40u flour, 10u butter and 5u water. - [bold]Cornmeal dough[/bold]: 15u cornmeal and 6u egg. - [bold]Tortilla dough[/bold]: 15u cornmeal and 10u water. - [bold]Cake batter[/bold]: 20u flour, 10u butter, 6u egg and 10u milk; or 15u flour and 15u soy milk. - [bold]Butter[/bold]: 30u cream and 1u salt. - [bold]Cheese[/bold]: 40u milk and 5u enzyme. - [bold]Tofu[/bold]: 55u soy milk and 5u enzyme. - [bold]Meatball[/bold]: 5u raw animal protein, 5u flour and 6u egg. - [bold]Chocolate bar[/bold]: 4u cocoa powder and 2u milk.
## Sauces - [bold]Ketchup[/bold]: tomato juice. - [bold]Mayonnaise[/bold]: 5u oil, 6u egg and 5u vinegar or lemon juice. - [bold]BBQ sauce[/bold]: ketchup and vinegar. - [bold]Ketchunaise[/bold]: ketchup and mayonnaise. - [bold]Hot sauce[/bold]: tomato juice, salt and capsaicin oil. - [bold]Soy sauce[/bold]: 2u soy milk and 1u sulfuric acid. - [bold]Vinegar[/bold]: ethanol and oxygen. - [bold]Vinaigrette[/bold]: vinegar, olive oil and black pepper.
